stats_note: YouTube rounds the subscriber count (for example 1,230,000 for 1,234,567): this is normal.
err_hidden: YouTube hides your subscriber count: make it public in YouTube Studio.
err_auth: The YouTube key is refused: check it in Settings.
err_rate: YouTube has reached its request limit for today: nothing to do, it will resume by itself.
err_network: YouTube is not answering right now: nothing to do, we try again automatically.
err_config_key: Add your YouTube key in Settings to follow your statistics (free: the guide “How do I create my YouTube key?” is at the top of this page).
err_config_channel: YouTube cannot find this channel: check the channel id in Settings (it starts with UC).
guide_title: How do I create my YouTube key? (free, about 5 minutes)
guide_intro: This key lets your site read your subscriber, video and view counts. It gives no access to your YouTube account.
guide_step1: Open the Google console (button below) and sign in with the Google account of your choice.
guide_step2: At the top of the page, click the project name, then “New project”. Give it a name (for example “My site”), create it and check that it is selected.
guide_step3: Menu “APIs & Services” then “Library”. Search for “YouTube Data API v3”, open it and click “Enable”. This is the step people forget most often.
guide_step4: Menu “APIs & Services” then “Credentials”. Click “Create credentials”, then “API key”. Google shows the key: copy it.
guide_step5: Recommended: click “Restrict key”, and under “API restrictions” choose “YouTube Data API v3” only. Leave application restrictions on “None”: your site calls YouTube, not a browser.
guide_step6: Paste the key into the “YouTube key” field on this page, save, then tick “Track my statistics”.
guide_err1: Check that “YouTube Data API v3” is enabled on the project that holds the key (step 3).
guide_err2: Check that no website restriction is set on the key.
guide_err3: Wait a few minutes: a brand-new key can take a little while to work.
guide_note: Never share this key: someone could use up your free quota. It is more than enough for this module.
